_about: Consistency test: the same question several times plus reworded versions, each in a fresh conversation. Ratings must match and the key numbers stay within the tolerances. Claude Opus 5.5 does not accept a temperature setting (the API rejects it), so the default is the lowest available and this test measures the run-to-run spread at that setting.
question: Rate Coca-Cola (KO) stock over 12 months.
rewordings: What's your 12-month view on Coca-Cola shares (NYSE: KO)? Give the rating and scenarios.
Give me your Overweight / Equal-weight / Underweight call on KO for the next year, with the numbers.
